======================================================
  PUZZLE PLANET — UPLOAD / INSTALL NOTES  (v3 package)
======================================================

PACKAGE CONTENTS
----------------
  planets.html                      <- the game page (pre-named for you)
  assets/index-om7_Ztoi.js          <- the actual game (ALL of it)
  assets/index-CkomTwBo.css         <- the game's styling
  index.html                        <- identical to planets.html (ignore)
  UPLOAD-NOTES.txt                  <- this file (do not upload)

!!! THE ONE RULE !!!
--------------------
planets.html and the assets folder must ALWAYS come from the SAME
download, and be placed in the SAME folder. planets.html by itself is
an EMPTY SHELL - without its matching assets folder you get a black
screen. Never mix files from different downloads (asset filenames like
"index-om7_Ztoi.js" change with every build - that is what caused the
black screens before).


OPTION A - GitHub Pages (your case)
-----------------------------------
1. On GitHub, DELETE everything currently inside dinos/planets/
   (old planets.html, old index.html, old assets folder).
2. Upload from THIS package:
       planets.html
       assets/index-om7_Ztoi.js
       assets/index-CkomTwBo.css
   so the repo looks exactly like:
       dinos/planets/planets.html
       dinos/planets/assets/index-om7_Ztoi.js
       dinos/planets/assets/index-CkomTwBo.css
3. Push, wait about 2 minutes for GitHub Pages to publish.
4. Open  https://talented-nation.github.io/dinos/planets/planets.html
   and press Ctrl+Shift+R (hard refresh - old broken copies are cached!).

Trouble? The page now explains itself: if a file is missing it shows a
"Houston, we have a problem!" panel listing every file it tried with
clickable links. A link that 404s tells you exactly which file is
missing from the repo.


OPTION B - run locally (double-click)
-------------------------------------
Keep planets.html and the assets folder together in one folder, then
double-click planets.html (Chrome or Edge recommended). It works even
from file:// thanks to the built-in fallback loader.
Your progress (best score + Galactic Journal) is saved per browser.


OPTION C - any other static host (Netlify, itch.io, school server...)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
Upload the whole folder contents as-is. The page auto-detects paths,
so it works at a site root, in a subfolder, or on any host.
